description: Valanghe - fotointerpretazione is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by territorio.provincia.tn.it. Analysis of the potential danger of avalanches on the provincial territory; each polygon represents the maximum extent that each avalanche can have reached based on the evidence found through the interpretation of aerial photos (damage to vegetation, presence of detritic conoids, etc. ). Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Avalanches — photointerpretation" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include OGD, open data, RNDT, SIAT, valanghe. The listing shows 2011-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
